scope: Primary-source model reference, direct implementation comparison, and separately labeled engineering experiments

sources.comparison: Our independently integrated model reference reproduces the printed basin free energies. Short local trajectories test the same model with different bandwidth rules and a much smaller budget; they are not a full reproduction of the paper's convergence curves.
locations: Supporting Information S1 and S3, printed pages 16-17

published_values.interpretation: Preserve printed notation; do not infer a statistical confidence interval from its parentheses.

sources.title: Exploration vs Convergence Speed in Adaptive-Bias Enhanced Sampling

differences: Authors use 200000000 MD steps per run
Authors use PLUMED adaptive widths and compression
Local runs use fixed literal sigma=0.1 or the explicitly documented deposition-Welford rule
Local runs freeze the bias for independent equilibrium reweighting
An independent harmonic z coordinate embeds the exact 2D problem in the public Cartesian API
Paper Figure4 averages25 independent runs; local primary groups use4 selected documented input seeds, not the full25-run ensemble.
parameters_used: four documented seeds and initial positions
